_purpose: Approved pytest configuration sources for the graded session (Gate 4N-I28Y).
_why_this_file_exists: Gate 4N-I28X bypass 1 needed no command-line change at all: `collect_ignore` in
tests/conftest.py removed both assertion-control modules from the graded run. Selection
can be altered from configuration as easily as from argv, so constraining argv alone
would have closed one door and left the other open.
_note: This repository deliberately carries NO pytest.ini, pyproject.toml, tox.ini or setup.cfg. Adding one is a collection-affecting change and must be approved here.
